svg.aria-label: Set up Sage access to the company’s chosen platforms
svg.title: Set up Sage access to the company’s chosen platforms
svg.desc: Detailed customer onboarding swimlane. Four stage bands: review setup and choose action; complete shared checks; complete public and/or private platform setup and confirm access; confirm platform use and show results. Native lanes distinguish customer/accountant, ERP/product, E-Invoice Service, Other Services and external platforms. Both public and private results return to the ERP platform-setup stage before the common platform-use decision. Setup alone does not activate a platform. Existing setup and matching current evidence are reused. Each platform requires its own readiness checks. Failed or pending steps use the shared recovery note and ONB-08/11. Responsibilities are proposed; implementation coverage and external contracts remain subject to SPEC039 qualification.

g.text: Set up Sage access to the company’s chosen platforms
Follow the ERP / product row from left to right. Each stage requests its checks below and uses their results before continuing.
BEFORE CUSTOMER ONBOARDING · SXS and Tax / Connections Service product integrations are available. SPEC038 §4.
3 · COMPLETE PLATFORM SETUP AND CONFIRM ACCESS
4 · CONFIRM PLATFORM USE AND SHOW RESULTS
Check view permission and SXS mapping; show permitted saved setup
Complete platform setup and confirm access
Public and/or private functions · Reuse valid setup; complete only missing, changed or expired work
Set up or reuse Sage connection
check only missing or stale items

IF ANY STEP FAILS OR REMAINS PENDING · Stop dependent work. Keep independent successful results. Show the limitation, next action and owner. Resume only affected work; check unknown effects before retrying. ONB-08/11.
Green: customer and ERP steps · Purple: setup and checks · Solid: normal work, requests and results · Dashed: conditional work.
Proposed responsibilities; implementation coverage remains open in SPEC039. Colours do not show readiness or implementation. Phase 1: public access; phases 2–3 add private setup and enabled changes.
